Analysis from today's forward-looking perspective (sunk cost excluded):

Inputs:
- Sunk spent = $900,000.00 (gone either way, excluded)
- Cost to finish = $200,000.00
- P(success) = 70% = 0.70
- Return if success = $800,000.00
- P(failure) = 1 - 0.70 = 0.30
- Return if failure = $0.00
- Sale value if stop now = $0.00

EV if stop:
EV_stop = sale value = $0.00 = 0

EV if continue:
EV_continue = P(success)*Return_success + P(failure)*Return_failure - Cost_to_finish
EV_continue = 0.70*$800,000.00 + 0.30*$0.00 - $200,000.00
EV_continue = $560,000.00 + $0.00 - $200,000.00
EV_continue = $360,000.00

Recomputed comparison:
$360,000.00 (continue) > $0.00 (stop)

Better decision is continue with expected value from today $360,000.00.

{"choice": "continue", "value": 360000}
